response.sql: SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AvgUnitPrice, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS AvgBytesPerMillisecond FROM Track t INNER JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name

assumptions.assumption: Grouping is per media type (MediaTypeId and Name), so media types sharing the same name would be listed as separate rows; MediaType.Name is assumed to be unique in practice.
Bytes divided by Milliseconds is computed as real (non-integer) division per track before averaging, so the result is not truncated. Milliseconds is NOT NULL and assumed to be nonzero.
